title: Neural LoFi with Backward Coupling: A Spectral Theory of Cross-Layer Feature Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32849v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: During joint training, backpropagation allows later layers to reshape earlier representations, a feedback mechanism absent from purely layer-wise learning. We extend Neural Low-Degree Filtering (Neural LoFi), a recently proposed layer-wise spectral surrogate for feature learning, to capture this interaction. Starting from the exact backpropagation gradients, we derive a local coupling between a neuron's incoming weights and its corresponding next-layer column. In a controlled small-initialization regime with smooth activations and fixed surroundings, these dynamics amplify singular modes of a cross-layer correlation operator. Each growing mode pairs an earlier feature with an upper-layer response through shared neuron coefficients. This motivates a backward-coupling algorithm in which upper-layer sensitivities generate sample-dependent effective labels for earlier spectral steps, while corrected features refine upward transmission. translated_title: 带反向耦合的神经低度滤波：跨层特征学习的谱理论
translated_abstract: 在联合训练中，反向传播允许后面的层重塑前面的表示，这种反馈机制在纯逐层学习中是不存在的。我们扩展了神经低度滤波（Neural LoFi）——一种最近提出的用于特征学习的逐层谱替代方法——以捕捉这种交互作用。从精确的反向传播梯度出发，我们推导出神经元的输入权重与其对应的下一层列之间的局部耦合。在具有平滑激活函数和固定周围环境的受控小初始化条件下，这些动力学会放大跨层相关算子的奇异模式。每个增长的模式通过共享的神经元系数将较早层的特征与上层响应配对。这启发了一种反向耦合算法：上层敏感性为较早的谱步骤生成依赖于样本的有效标签，同时经过修正的特征则细化向上传输的信息。
tldr: 该论文提出带反向耦合的神经低度滤波谱理论，从反向传播梯度推导出跨层局部耦合动力学，利用上层敏感性为早期谱步骤生成有效标签，从而在逐层学习框架中实现跨层特征交互。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Neural LoFi into a backward-coupling spectral theory, deriving local cross-layer coupling dynamics from exact backpropagation gradients, where upper-layer sensitivities generate effective labels for earlier spectral steps to capture cross-layer feature learning interactions.
